challenge: Mild, dry Saturday in New Buffalo, mid-60s from 1 to 5 PM with the wind dying off. Two days after legs, make it a moderate Total Gym upper session plus an afternoon walk, nothing to failure with labs Tuesday.
constraint: Labs are Tue Oct 27, 10:20 AM. Train normally, but keep it moderate (nothing to failure) Oct 25–26.
items: Total Gym upper: 3 x 12 rows, 3 x 10 chest press, 3 x 12 biceps curls, 2 x 12 triceps, stop 2 reps short of failure
Brisk 45 min walk (beach or trail), mid-afternoon (~66–68°F, light wind)
30 min easy kayak if the lake is calm after 3 PM; dress for cold water (optional)
